description.en-US: The conversations between Fénelon and the Chevalier Ramsay (1710), written up by Ramsay after Fénelon: a second-hand text, taken from the History of the Life and Works of Fénelon (Brussels, 1723).
description.pt-BR: As conversas entre Fénelon e o cavaleiro de Ramsay (1710), redigidas por Ramsay a partir de Fénelon: texto de segunda mão, extraído da História da vida e das obras de Fénelon (Bruxelas, 1723).

fr-FR.editor: J.-E.-A. Gosselin (éd. Saint-Sulpice), Paris: Leroux et Jouby / Gaume

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Fénelon, Paris, Leroux et Jouby, 1851 (éd. Gosselin, Saint-Sulpice), tome 1, p. 218–230; archive.org OCR (ABBYY).
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary; period spelling kept. Residual OCR errors remain (see PROBLEMS.md). After Fénelon, in Ramsay’s redaction.
sources.tierEvidence: Fénelon died in 1715; the 1851 edition is public domain.
